svg.aria-label: Context: What: Netra grades the carbon credits a company says it retired. Registry data, published research, the company's own report and an independent emissions estimate, side by side. Each check is recorded on a public blockchain. For: the public and journalists (is this claim real?), scientists

g.text: What: Netra grades the carbon credits a company says it retired. Registry data, published research, the
company's own report and an independent emissions estimate, side by side. Each check is recorded on a public
For: the public and journalists (is this claim real?), scientists (open data and method), buyers and auditors (due
diligence), regulators (EU Directive 2024/825 on green claims).
Name: netra is Sanskrit for "eye", also known in Indonesian. Short, easy to say worldwide.
